nodes.name: Corruption
nodes.summary: The in-world corrupting power named by the Karui and Vaal (Kitava as 'God of Corruption', worship of Corruption at a Vaal temple) and carried as the Seed of Corruption (what remains of the Beast) in PoE2. The item-corruption mechanic is a separate game system.

sources.locator: Haku dialogue: 'Kitava, God of Corruption'
PoE2 section: 'the Seed of Corruption'
Vaal temple section: 'worship of Corruption'

edges.description: The Exile places Balbala's Barya (the barya holding Balbala's soul) into the Relic Altar of the Trial of the Sekhemas, per the Ascent to Power quest.

edges.description: Shambrin: 'Her barya contains her soul'; the barya is the vessel of Balbala's soul.

edges.description: Ascent to Power is unlocked by picking up Balbala's Barya; the wiki says that if Balbala is not defeated in Traitor's Passage and the quest barya picked up, she grants Balbala's Barya at the Trial instead.

sources.locator: Quest note: 'if you have not defeated Balbala, the Traitor in Traitor's Passage and picked up the quest barya, Balbala will grant Balbala's Barya here'
